name: Asustor AS6706T
source: Asustor AS6702T/AS6704T/AS6706T quick installation guide (ASUSTOR_AS67XXT_QIG_ENU_20220108_V3.pdf): six 3.5in bays side by side under the LCD panel; the bay order is the one of the platform driver's LED table (sata1..sata6) and of the plugin's LED daemon (bay N = the Nth port of the ASM1166), not measured on a unit. Board: the asustor-platform-driver identifies the AS6706T by its DMI names and the ASMedia ASM1166 [1b21:1166] SATA controller.

calibration.note: Not measured: the bays follow the ASM1166's ports in order (port 1 = bay 1, left), as the LED daemon and the platform driver's LED table assume. Until a Locate test on a unit confirms it (LEDs and Buttons tab), every bay is labelled 'bay order not confirmed'. The plugin passes a unit's order, confirmed or corrected, as the cabling object of the unit 'none'.

host_view: Fan: one 120 mm fan on the board's IT8625E controller. Its speed is readable; a fan plugin (ex. FanCtrl Plus) sets it.
LEDs and buttons: driven by the Asustor Platform Driver and this plugin's LED daemon, when the LED drivers are loaded.
LCD: driven by this plugin over a serial port.
M.2 slots: four, inside the unit under the cover; their NVMe drives are listed under the drawing.

panel.source: Asustor AS67XXT quick installation guide (version 4.0.0108, 2022-01-08, V3 file): LED indicators p.34 (power, system status, network, USB and hard disk LEDs on the AS6706T front), rear panel p.35 (2.5G RJ45 ports, USB 3.2 Gen 2, HDMI, reset button, K-Lock, system fan, PCI Express 3.0 expansion slot, power supply unit), LCD buttons p.36 (Up, Down, Back, Confirm right of the LCD). Units: the guide's photos measured at 300 and 220 dpi; schematic, not to scale.
panel.note: The LEDs and the LCD are driven by this plugin when its drivers are loaded; the drawing does not show their live state. The fan's speed is in the hardware monitor under the drawing.

trays.led_title: %s LED: green = a drive is in the bay, blinking = activity; red = Unraid reports a fault. Driven by this plugin's LED daemon (LEDs and Buttons tab).

parts.title: LCD panel: two lines of text, driven by this plugin (LCD tab).
LCD buttons: Up, Back (top), Down, Confirm (bottom). They run the LCD menu of Asustor's own firmware; this plugin does not read them.

titles: System status LED: green steady = array started, slow blink = parity check or rebuild, fast blink = array stopped; red = a disk is disabled, invalid or missing.
Network LED: blue = a network port is connected.
Network LED: blue = a network port is connected.
USB LED: green = a USB device in the front port.
parts.note: Driven by the Asustor Platform Driver and this plugin's LED daemon when the LED drivers are loaded.

notes: Fan: one 120 mm fan on the board's fan controller; its speed is under the drawing.
A fan plugin (ex. FanCtrl Plus) sets the speed; this plugin only reads it.
LAN, USB and HDMI are Unraid's own; the PCIe slot takes an optional 10GbE card.

parts.title: Power input (AC in) of the internal 250 W power supply

parts.label: PCIe slot
parts.title: PCI Express 3.0 expansion slot (cover): for an optional 10GbE card
System fan, 120 mm: on the board's IT8625E controller. Its speed is readable (hardware monitor, History); a fan plugin sets it.
